title: Patch 1.3.1.4
text: Released on 20/11/2024 Fixed localization issues with Traderun: Dewstone to Two Crowns Fixed localization for Bound Destruction Preventive Charm Fixed epherium accessory salvaging wisp amount Increased Whalesong and Aegis Island leadership rewards from 10 to 20. Fixed localization with Daru Trinket costumes Updated localization on Bound Destruction Preventive Charm to reflect that it does not prevent downgrade. Ode to Recovery will now weave again Freshwater Fish Schools have been reverted to their normal version. This also means Family Fishing has been corrected You'll have to use Chum or Rainbow Chum to activate Freshwater pools Freshwater Fish have seen their gold values increased to make the activity not a slap in the face. Fry will have a base value of 14.5, normal 18 and garg 25 The ratio values for Dragon Essence Stabilizers have been adjusted upwards. This brings them more in line with their 3.0 value Fixed Greenman Kart localization Fixed localization for Cow Kart Fixed localization for Moo Bus Fixed localization for Kitty Onesie Fixed localization for Puppy Onesie Fixed localization for Reckless Ravager's Plate Fixed localization for Dairy Farmer Costume Fixed localization for Milkmaid Costume Fixed localization for Eclipse Knight Costume Fixed localization with Daru Trinket costumes Updated the icons on the Duskgleam and Veroe customization crates. The Ghost Wedding Festival has started in White Arden! It will run until the 4th of December The daily event will happen at 12:00, 19:00 and midnight Server Time The Experimenting Again quest has been disabled properly In its stead, a new category is available on the workbench in Hasla: Emerald Destruction. It'll allow destroying a weapon and getting a new emerald!
html:
Released on 20/11/2024

  • Fixed localization issues with Traderun: Dewstone to Two Crowns
  • Fixed localization for Bound Destruction Preventive Charm
  • Fixed epherium accessory salvaging wisp amount
  • Increased Whalesong and Aegis Island leadership rewards from 10 to 20.
  • Fixed localization with Daru Trinket costumes
  • Updated localization on Bound Destruction Preventive Charm to reflect that it does not prevent downgrade.
  • Ode to Recovery will now weave again
  • Freshwater Fish Schools have been reverted to their normal version. This also means Family Fishing has been corrected
  • You'll have to use Chum or Rainbow Chum to activate Freshwater pools
  • Freshwater Fish have seen their gold values increased to make the activity not a slap in the face. Fry will have a base value of 14.5, normal 18 and garg 25
  • The ratio values for Dragon Essence Stabilizers have been adjusted upwards. This brings them more in line with their 3.0 value
  • Fixed Greenman Kart localization
  • Fixed localization for Cow Kart
  • Fixed localization for Moo Bus
  • Fixed localization for Kitty Onesie
  • Fixed localization for Puppy Onesie
  • Fixed localization for Reckless Ravager's Plate
  • Fixed localization for Dairy Farmer Costume
  • Fixed localization for Milkmaid Costume
  • Fixed localization for Eclipse Knight Costume
  • Fixed localization with Daru Trinket costumes
  • Updated the icons on the Duskgleam and Veroe customization crates.
  • The Ghost Wedding Festival has started in White Arden! It will run until the 4th of December
    • The daily event will happen at 12:00, 19:00 and midnight Server Time
  • The Experimenting Again quest has been disabled properly
  • In its stead, a new category is available on the workbench in Hasla: Emerald Destruction. It'll allow destroying a weapon and getting a new emerald!
